name: anuar-free-ai-console
description: Separate VS Code panel for the local free-claude-code gateway.

freeAiConsole.autoStartGateway.description: Automatically start the local free-claude-code gateway when the Free AI panel opens.

freeAiConsole.gatewayCommand.description: Command used to start the local free-claude-code gateway.

freeAiConsole.gatewayStartupTimeoutSecon.description: Maximum time to wait for the local gateway to become healthy after starting it.

freeAiConsole.autoStartOllama.description: Automatically start local Ollama when the Free AI panel opens or a local provider is used.

freeAiConsole.ollamaCommand.description: Command used to start the local Ollama server.

freeAiConsole.ollamaModelsDirectory.description: OLLAMA_MODELS directory used when Free AI starts Ollama. Leave empty to use Ollama's default model store.

freeAiConsole.ollamaStartupTimeoutSecond.description: Maximum time to wait for Ollama to become healthy after starting it.

freeAiConsole.defaultProvider.description: Default provider for Free AI Console.

freeAiConsole.stepAgentPlannerProvider.description: Planner provider used by Step Agent before local Ollama executes small steps.

freeAiConsole.stepAgentMaxSteps.description: Maximum number of small Ollama steps Step Agent may run for one request.

freeAiConsole.stepAgentRepairPasses.description: How many short repair passes Step Agent may run after verification finds issues.

freeAiConsole.stepAgentStepMaxTokens.description: Maximum output tokens for each local Ollama Step Agent step.

freeAiConsole.freePolicy.description: Free usage policy for auto routing.

freeAiConsole.autoMode.description: Auto routing mode. Balanced uses one cheap provider plus fallback; compare asks several providers; survival uses local Ollama.

freeAiConsole.openCodeCommand.description: OpenCode command used by the OpenCode Agent provider.

freeAiConsole.openCodeModel.description: OpenCode Agent model in provider/model format. Local Ollama models run through the built-in file-agent path for project edits.

freeAiConsole.openCodeFallbackToOllama.description: Retry OpenCode with the local Ollama model when a non-local provider is rate limited.

freeAiConsole.providerCooldownMinutes.description: Minutes to avoid a provider after rate limit or provider failure.

freeAiConsole.localCoderModel.description: Local Ollama model used for survival mode and OpenCode fallback.

freeAiConsole.requestTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time for one provider request before the test or chat moves on.
